```
@flat 2
service = "ledger-sync"
enabled = on
owner = ~
motd = "Say ""hi"" to ops"
paths/spool = "C:\spool\ledger"
paths/<log dir> = "/var/log/ledger sync"
paths/templates = []
limits/max_batch = 2500
limits/ttl_seconds = 86_400
limits/ratio = 0.500
limits/burst = 1_250_000
limits/backoff = 1.250
servers#1/host = "eu-1.ledger.example"
servers#1/port = 8443
servers#1/tls = on
servers#1/api_secret = <redacted:10>
servers#2/host = "us-1.ledger.example"
servers#2/port = 8443
servers#2/tls = off
servers#2/api_secret = <redacted:14>
banner = "Line one^nLine two ^^ top"
tags#1 = "billing"
tags#2 = "eu/west"
tags#3 = ""
extra = {}
@end 25
```
